name: El Calafate
tagline: Gateway to the Perito Moreno Glacier
summary: El Calafate is a small town on turquoise Lago Argentino and the base for Los Glaciares National Park. Walk the boardwalks facing the thundering Perito Moreno Glacier, trek on the ice, and head to El Chaltén for Fitz Roy hikes.
seasonNote: October to April is the season; winter is cold and quiet.
arrival: El Calafate Airport is 20 minutes away; flights from Buenos Aires and Ushuaia.
gettingAround: Tours and buses to the glacier and El Chaltén.
cashTip: Argentine prices and exchange rules change quickly; treat peso prices as rough guides. Cards work widely; foreign cards often get a favourable rate.
